hypothesis: Restricting rising MA20 market breadth from 30%-50% to 30%-40% should focus clean RS90 VCP entries on the early recovery window; development candidates in this band showed materially stronger fast-breakout and 20-day follow-through than the 40%-50% band.
trial_note: Only the upper market-breadth entry bound changes relative to the clean-pivot trailing protocol. Individual-stock filters, exit rules, costs, ten slots, universe and development interval remain frozen.
